title: GET /report-subscriptions – query
description: Both filters together: that user's subscriptions on that site. Query string parameters, each at most once (as strings in the URL; the schema describes them decoded). Absent parameter: no filter. A malformed value is 422 validation_failed.

site_id.description: Only the subscriptions of this site; a site the caller does not see gives an empty list.

user_id.description: Only the subscriptions of this user.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page; absent: the first page.
